facts.fact: The abstract says community health worker smartphone data on births and perinatal deaths (729 live births and 35 perinatal deaths in eight months, four districts) were analysed on DHIS2 and that the DISK-Mali tool is integrated into the DHIS2 platform.

systems.tiers: community health workers, four health districts (Diéma, Kita, Sikasso, Kignan)

note: Document gives no date for the integration; as_of is the publication year (2026).
